title: One command scaffolds a new site and its newsroom data
description:
Requested by Humorus (https://github.com/AnthusAI/Humorus), the satire publications that run a second, very different newsroom on Papyrus. Humorus issue: HUM-dc9f71.

`papyrus site init` creates a site folder that builds and passes its tests, with no AWS identifier in any file, and works inside a monorepo that already holds a deployment. A newsroom scaffold writes agent instructions, the Story procedure, image rules and starter policies as editable records, with profiles (news, satire). A scaffold diff shows where a site differs from current defaults and changes nothing. The scaffold defaults become the only editorial opinion in Papyrus code.

comments.author: home
comments.text: From Humorus, 2026-11-13 (first real site brought up through the account pipeline). Scaffold must account for: (1) The Amplify console 'Connect repository' wizard replaces the branch: it wiped every branch environment variable (tenant id, Cognito prefix, redirect URLs, ...), turned auto-build ON and started a build (job 1) that ran with no variables. CloudFormation cannot see this drift, so re-running the stack changes nothing; it had to be re-applied by changing a stack input. The scaffold's connect-the-repository instructions must say: the wizard resets the branch, expect the variables to be re-applied by a stack update, and auto-build must go back to false (deploys start from GitHub Actions). Better: the app-shell stack should own and re-assert branch settings. (2) A new site's infra/site.json must write the four PAPYRUS_ENABLE_* flags (console responder defaults ON and needs a container image; that failed the first auto-build). (3) The email block is now mandatory in 5.104+. (4) The first build needs the two-pass bootstrap; the pipeline's first-build workflow does it.
